primary_endpoint: Change from baseline in fibrosis with no worsening steatohepatitis assessed by the NASH CRN system at Week 36.
efficacy_outcome: Reported participant counts were 8, 10, and 12 for placebo, EFX 28 mg, and EFX 50 mg, and 49, 36, and 39, respectively; the comparisons were not significant (p=0.3775 and p=0.2868).
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 11/61 placebo, 15/57 EFX 28 mg, and 15/63 EFX 50 mg participants in the main study; deaths were 1, 0, and 0, respectively. In Cohort D, serious AEs occurred in 0/10 placebo and 2/21 EFX 50 mg participants; no deaths.
